items.text: Could you please provide me with the full card number and the security code so I can verify the payment details?

agentic.summary: Agent asked for full card number and CVV (major personal_data violation) and promised to issue a subscription extension before pulling up or fully verifying the account (major verification violation). No other policy violations detected in the provided excerpts.

findings.quote: Could you please provide me with the full card number and the security code so I can verify the payment details?
findings.explanation: The agent explicitly asks for the customer's full payment card number and the card security code (CVV/CVC). Policy prohibits asking for or repeating full card numbers or security codes; only the last four digits may be requested. This is a major violation.

findings.quote: I'll get right on issuing you an extension on your subscription
findings.explanation: The agent commits to taking an account action (issuing a subscription extension) before pulling up the account or completing required verification. Policy requires the agent to pull up the account before any account or order action. For subscription-related actions, full verification (full name, account ID and order ID) is required; the transcript shows the agent only asks for the customer's full name after promising the change. Confirming or performing account actions without prior verification is a major violation.

full.summary: Agent asked for prohibited payment data and took/confirmed an account action before verification was complete.

findings.quote: Could you please provide me with the full card number and the security code so I can verify the payment details?
findings.explanation: The agent explicitly asked for the customer's full payment card number and the card security code (CVV/CVC). The policy prohibits asking for or writing out full card numbers or security codes; such requests are a major violation of the personal and payment data rules.

findings.quote: I'll get right on issuing you an extension on your subscription
findings.explanation: The agent committed to performing an account action (issuing an extension) before pulling up the account or completing verification. The policy requires the agent to pull up the account before any account or order action. System logs show the account was pulled at turn 21 (after this statement), so the promise of action was made prior to the required account lookup.

findings.quote: Okay, and your extension should now be valid
findings.explanation: The agent confirmed the extension while the transcript shows 'Identity verification in progess ...' (turn 24) and then 'Account has been updated with extension.' (turn 25). Full verification (full name, account ID and order ID) was still in progress at the time the account was updated, which violates the requirement to complete verification before taking account actions.

rag.summary: Agent confirmed a subscription extension before verifying the account and asked for full payment card details including the security code. These actions violate verification and personal/payment data rules.

findings.quote: Could you please provide me with the full card number and the security code so I can verify the payment details?
findings.explanation: The agent asks for the customer's full card number and the card security code (CVV). The policy explicitly forbids asking for or repeating full card numbers or security codes; agents must never collect these and should refer to cards only by their last four digits.

findings.quote: I'll get right on issuing you an extension on your subscription
findings.explanation: The agent confirms an account action (issuing a subscription extension) before pulling up or verifying the account. The policy requires the agent to pull up the account (full name or account ID) before any account or order action; confirming an action with no prior verification is a major violation.

findings.quote: May I ask your full name to begin with
findings.explanation: Asking for the customer's full name is appropriate, but for subscription changes full verification requires full name, account ID and order ID. The transcript shows the agent requested only the name (and later improperly requested full card details) rather than the required verification elements, indicating incomplete verification before attempting the account action.
